title: Panda géant - tête (Ailuropoda melanoleuca) (1)
alt_text: Sunlit close-up profile of an adult giant panda's head and shoulders, showing the black patch around its eye, a rounded black ear, long white whiskers and a broad black nose, set against a blurred green bamboo background.

title: Giant panda eating bamboo
alt_text: A giant panda sitting upright in grass in front of a large grey boulder, gripping a peeled bamboo stalk in its front paws and chewing the end of it while looking toward the camera.

title: Panda Cub Xiao Qi Ji 03 - Climbing Trunk
alt_text: A giant panda cub standing on its hind legs on a green lawn, hugging a leaning bare tree trunk with both front paws and stretching its muzzle up along the bark, with a cut bamboo stalk lying on the grass behind it.

title: Ailuropoda melanoleuca (Panda géant) - 445
alt_text: An adult giant panda reclining against a large boulder on a grassy zoo lawn, seated amid a wide scattered pile of cut bamboo stalks and leaves that covers its lap, looking toward the camera.

title: Qinling Giant Panda, Shaanxi, China
alt_text: A wild giant panda sitting on the leaf-littered floor of a dense bamboo thicket in the Qinling Mountains of Shaanxi, partly screened by thin green bamboo stems and ferns as it turns its head toward the camera.
